skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my clips into a finished video without downloading any software — and...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Maker Free Browser: create and edit videos directly in the browser with no software downloads.
- Supports MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI uploads up to 500MB, with fully automatic cloud-based video creation.
- Fast processing: generate finished MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes using a browser interface.
- Simplified setup with automatic token generation and session handling.
- Full support for common workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinements.
- Clear error messages and guidance for unsupported formats, file size issues, and plan limitations.
